root_cause.text: The imx8mp-hdmi-blk-ctrl driver dynamically gated the NOC_HDCP clock (HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 BIT(11)) during HDCP power domain transitions, but the clock must remain always enabled to prevent a system hang caused by the NoC ADB400 port power down handshake.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the setting/clearing of BIT(11) in HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 during `imx8mp_hdmi_blk_ctrl_power_on()` and `imx8mp_hdmi_blk_ctrl_power_off()` for the `IMX8MP_HDMIBLK_PD_HDCP` case, and instead adds BIT(11) to the initial clock configuration in the power notifier to keep it always on.

This write clears the entire HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 register, including BIT(11) (NOC_HDCP clock), potentially gating the clock unexpectedly and contributing to the same hang scenario.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement disables the NOC_HDCP clock (BIT(11)) during HDCP power domain power-off. Since the clock must remain always enabled, disabling it directly triggers a system hang due to NoC ADB400 port power down handshake.
This write clears the entire HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 register, including BIT(11) which controls the NOC_HDCP clock. This unexpectedly gates the clock, contributing to the system hang scenario.
